name: v1.0 systematic macro strategy (carry/trend/value; FX and bonds; 10% vol target)
hypothesis: A cross-country composite of carry, trend and value z-scores in 10 currencies and 13 bond positions earns a positive risk-adjusted return after costs out of sample
result: 2020-01..2026-09: +6.0%/yr compounded, Sharpe 0.65, max drawdown -18.5%, S&P 500 correlation -0.17 (design sample Sharpe 0.40)

name: Gold event trades (geopolitical/macro events; rules a-c)
hypothesis: Gold's net move in the 5 days after a geopolitical or macro event persists to 20 days, so trading in the direction of the 5-day move (or buying after any event) earns more than gold's drift after costs
test_type: in-sample rule test on a hand list and a mechanical event list
result: In-sample Sharpe: a (buy if net 5d > +1%) 0.05 hand / -0.06 mechanical; b (sell if < -1%) -0.06 / -0.25; c (buy after any event) -0.09 / 0.25 vs buy-and-hold gold 0.51. No rule beats gold's own drift after costs; with the 5 best trades removed all rules are negative
decision: rejected as a trading rule; frozen v1 kept as an explanatory model only
notes: Out-of-sample (2022-26) test of the frozen v1 explanatory model was run separately (beats no-change on errors); that is not a trading result

name: Fed decision model (v1; v1.1 political-pressure features; v1.2 SEP path and speech tone)
hypothesis: A model of FOMC decisions from macro data and Fed communication forecasts the decision better than fed funds futures
test_type: out-of-fold Brier score vs fed funds futures on the same meetings
result: 5-class Brier, 1 day: v1 0.452 / v1.1 0.512 / v1.2 0.466 vs futures 0.162 (n 125); 2 weeks: v1 0.384 / v1.1 0.437 / v1.2 0.391 vs futures 0.181 (n 67). Every version is worse than futures at every horizon with a futures benchmark
notes: v1.1 and v1.2 are counted in the same trial group as v1 (one idea per the spec's N = 7)

name: Tension index / geopolitical-risk gold rule (rule d)
hypothesis: A news-based tension index tracks the Caldara-Iacoviello GPR index; a rise in GPR of more than 1 SD in a week signals a profitable gold trade
test_type: index validation vs GPR; in-sample rule test
result: Index correlation with daily GPR 0.77. Rule d (buy gold if weekly GPR change > 1 SD): 59 trades, hit rate 56%, +0.16% per trade after cost (t 0.3), Sharpe 0.06 vs buy-and-hold 0.51
decision: rejected as a trading rule; index kept as a data series

name: Sovereign risk / spread fair-value model v1 (ridge + Driscoll-Kraay; spread forecast = -kappa x gap)
hypothesis: Spread gaps from a fundamentals fair value mean-revert and forecast 3- and 6-month spread changes better than no change
test_type: frozen parameters; single out-of-sample run; RMSE ratio vs no change with Diebold-Mariano t
result: Pooled RMSE ratio 1.00 (3m) / 0.98 (6m); 0.98 edge disappears without the 5 largest moves; France 1.59 / 2.34 (much worse)

name: Sovereign fair-value model v2 (post-hoc; separate spread equations over Bunds / USTs)
hypothesis: Same as v1 with separate spread equations; specified after seeing the v1 test
test_type: post-hoc refit evaluated on the same test period
result: Pooled RMSE ratio 1.00 (3m) / 0.98 (6m); France 1.08 / 1.18. Not an independent test
decision: not adopted as a forecast; shown on the dashboard labelled post-hoc
notes: Same trial group as T05 (the spec counts the fair-value model once)

name: Pre-election daily repricing (polls and Polymarket odds vs FX and 10y yields)
hypothesis: In the six months before a vote, currencies and 10y yields move day by day with the leading candidate's poll margin or win probability
result: Same-day FX response significant in 0 of 21 elections (polls) and 0 of 6 (odds); pooled polls +0.017% per pp (t 0.9). Only significant same-day coefficient: South Africa 2024 10y (thin market)

name: Euro-area election spread study (populist-vote surprise vs 10y spread over Bunds)
hypothesis: A populist vote-share surprise in a euro-area election predicts the day-1 change in that country's 10y spread over Bunds (pre-registered pass criteria, Section 7)
result: Primary FAIL: Pearson r = 0.060 (n 40) vs > 0.5 required; right sign 64.7% vs 70% required; ex-Greece r = 0.111 (n 34). Hand-coded robustness r = 0.031
decision: rejected (failed pre-registered criteria); Spain 2026 forecast only

name: Event-study election drift rule (fade the day-1 FX move; hold to day 5 or day 20)
hypothesis: The in-sample reversal of election-day FX moves is tradeable
result: Hold-out: day-5 hold -3.3%/yr, Sharpe -1.00 (14 trades, hit rate 29%); day-20 hold -4.8%/yr, Sharpe -0.53; carry basket +2.6%/yr, Sharpe 0.46
notes: Not in the spec's list of seven; added from this repository's history

name: v1 design alternative: no no-trade band (vs 25% band)
hypothesis: A 25% no-trade band improves net performance by cutting costs
result: 2005-2019 combined Sharpe 0.37 without band vs 0.40 with band; costs 5.9% vs 5.3%/yr; band kept
decision: band kept in v1.0; no-band config not adopted
notes: The one design choice tried on 2005-2019 for v1.0; a distinct config

name: Political-risk overlay rules (a) cut to zero and (b) halve positions from 5 days before to 1 day after scheduled political events
hypothesis: Stepping aside before scheduled political events improves risk-adjusted returns
test_type: rule chosen on design sample and frozen; single test run
result: 2005-2019: (a) Sharpe 0.25, (b) 0.33, (c) no change 0.40, so (c) frozen. 2020-26: cut 0.53, halve 0.60, no change 0.65
notes: Not in the spec's list of seven; added from this repository's history

name: T01 (pre-registered): time-series trend sleeve replacing v1.0's cross-sectional trend (core carry+value 80% / TSMOM sleeve 20% of risk)
code_ref: branch trial/T01-ts-trend; pre-registration dc71998; run at 62524ff
hypothesis: Replacing v1.0's cross-sectional trend signal with a separate time-series trend sleeve (spec 2.2 TSMOM blend, k in {1,3,6,12}) improves the strategy
design_sample: none (no parameters estimated; all fixed in advance by the spec and the pre-registration)
test_type: pre-registered single run; spec 0.3 pass rule (5 criteria)
result: FAIL (2 of 5 pre-registered criteria). 2020-01..2026-09, 1x costs: T01 Sharpe 0.80 vs v1.0 0.65 (dSR +0.15, block-bootstrap one-sided p 0.26: fail); holdout half B Sharpe 0.63 vs 0.72 (fail); MaxDD -14.0% vs -18.5% and ES97.5 5.40% vs 5.57% (pass); DSR 0.73 at N 8 vs 0.62 at N 7 (pass); trend-carry correlation in carry's worst 8 months +0.54 (fail). Trend sleeve alone Sharpe 0.03 (2020-26), -0.19 (2006-19)
decision: rejected (failed pre-registered pass rule); v1.0 stays live unchanged
notes: Ledger id T12 because T01 is already v1.0's ledger id; called T01 in the pre-registration, branch and results. Deflated Sharpe compared at spec N 7 -> 8
